messages.subject: observe output of hidden nodes
messages.body_plain:
Dear rsnns deverlopers,

How can I observe the output of hidden nodes in my mlp network. For keras I can do

# show input of softmax layer

layer_name <- 'dense_1';

chk_model <- keras_model(inputs=model$input, outputs=get_layer(model, layer_name)$output);

chko <- predict(chk_model, ph.test);

What is the corresponding code for a mlp model?

Thanks in advance,

Ad Denissen
Principal System Architect
Philips Research
Brain, Behaviour & Cognition
